messages:
jade_devex: Quick debrief from today's onboarding: users saw different env var names across samples and accidentally committed keys to a frontend build. We need a single canonical var and clearer docs.

kai_sdk: Agreed. Proposal: canonical `REDWOOD_API_KEY`, `REDWOOD_ORG_ID`, `REDWOOD_PROJECT_ID`. SDKs must prefer `REDWOOD_API_KEY` and log a masked deprecation warning if legacy `RW_API_KEY` is present.

li_se: Also confusion about key scope (org vs project). Recommend CLI default to creating project-scoped keys and surface scope in `redwood keys list` so new users don't use org keys by accident.

morgan_cli: I'll add a scope column and make `--scope=project` the default for create. Also add `redwood keys rotate KEY_ID --write-env .env --atomic` to rotate and write env files after a healthcheck.

kai_sdk: SDK rotation helper idea: accept a `rotation_token`, call `/v1/auth/rotate`, validate new creds with a quick health call, then atomically swap in-memory. No process restart. Provide examples for Python/Node.

li_se: Security: never print full secrets. Mask anything that looks like a key in logs and add unit tests to assert no raw keys appear. Also add docs about when to use org vs project keys.

jade_devex: Good. Kai will draft an RFC for env var parity, rotation, and idempotency handling by EOW. Morgan will land CLI UX changes next week. We'll update templates after SDK PRs merge.

kai_sdk: ACK, will include idempotency_key requirement for non-idempotent endpoints in the RFC.
